entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of those (horses) that run with a panting breath.
And by those who raid (on enemies) at dawn.
Then penetrate in the midst of the enemy forces.
Indeed, man is very ungrateful towards his Lord.
And indeed, he himself is witness to it.
And indeed, he definitely loves wealth to the extreme.
So, does he not know when those in the graves will be raised?
And all that which is in the chests will be disclosed.
Indeed, on that Day, their Lord knows all about them.
Then bring out sparks from stones by striking (their) hooves.
